Commentary.Commentary: So, Pakistan are under pressure at the moment and they will first look to see off the nervy few minutes before lunch unscathed and then think about the rest of the day. Australia will be full charged up as they would look to be right on the money from the word go. Can they sneak in a few early on? Or will Pakistan remain patient and see it off? Join us in a bit for Pakistan's reply...

Smith played the second fiddle today but he has led by an example yet again. He remained unbeaten but credit also goes to Warner and Khawaja for setting up the tone initially with the former getting to his ton and the latter missing out on it by a mere 3 runs. Handscomb and Starc added valuable contributions and helped their side post a mammoth in reply to the visitors' total.

This is really, really interesting now. Captain Smith has made the call that he has enough on the board and doesn't wait for his double ton but instead wants to have a crack at Pakistan just 20 minutes before lunch, a brave and aggressive move! The session started with Smith and Starc and boy, didn't they entertain one and all? Mitchell Starc was in crash-bang-wallop mode as he stitched a quickfire 154-run stand with his skipper and got the minimal crowd going.

OUT! Yasir Shah strikes! He comes over the wicket and tosses up a bit outside off and Lyon goes for a sweep again but gets a top top edge which goes straight up in the air. The leggie comes underneath it and takes it safely. With the wicket, AUSTRALIA HAVE DECLARED AND THEY LEAD BY 181 RUNS.
FOUR! Pitched outside leg, Lyon tries to sweep it again but he finds the edge of his bat and the ball tickles away towards the third man boundary from just wide of the keeper.
Outside leg, Smith paddles it behind the keeper for a single.
Again down the leg side, Lyon sweeps it again to find the fine leg fielder for a single.
FOUR! BEAUTY! Pitched outside leg and Lyon sweeps it elegantly through the fine leg region for a boundary.
Pitched outside leg, Lyon goes outside leg and tries to swing hard at it but is unable to make contact. The ball misses everything and goes straight to the keeper.
Fuller in length and outside off, Lyon drills it down to long off for a single to keep strike.

Slower one nearly worked! Sohail hurls a slower one outside off, Lyon waits for it and then seeing there is no pace on it he tries to generate some power. Ends up getting a top edge towards the off side. Sami Aslam from point comes sprinting in but the ball falls short of him and then goes through. They look to steal another one as the throw at the striker's end isn't that great. All happening at the 'G.
Swing and a miss! Fuller and angling in, Lyon backs away to swing it across the line but fails to get any wood on it.
In the air... falls short! A length ball on off, Smith tries to hit it flat down the ground towards long on. It goes in the air and falls short of the man coming across to his right. A single taken.
Angles a length ball on the hips, Smith shuffles a bit and clips it down to fine leg for a couple.
A fabulous partnership is finally broken. The home side would look to get some more runs under the belt before they will have a go at the visitors...
Nathan Lyon is the next man in, replacing Starc!

OUT! An entertaining knock by Starc comes to an end. He again misses out on his maiden Test hundred. That was short and a bit wide outside off, Starc stays in his crease and pulls it towards square leg where Asad Shafiq was waiting to pouch it.
Starc camps back and cuts it late through point for a single.
SIX! STARC is at it again. Tossed outside off and Starc has lofted that over mid on for a maximum. Power hitting by Starc.
Pitched way down leg, Smith tries to paddle sweep it but is unable to make contact. The ball hits the back pad and goes behind the keeper for a single. Leg bye is taken.
Tossed up outside off, Smith dives it towards covers.
Smith dances down the track and defends it well.
On the pads, Smith flicks it towards square leg for a couple.
A low full toss speared in, Starc looks to flick but gets it off the inside edge towards backward square leg for a brace.
Yorker on off, Starc does well to jam it out.
Stays inside the crease and drills it down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Runs coming now! Good length ball on middle, Smith bashes it through mid-wicket for another boundary.
Angles in a length ball on middle, MS looks to dig it out but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards the off side. A stifled appeal for LBW but it's not given. A leg bye taken.

FOUR! Easy pickings, that! Sohail tries to bowl the slower one but ends up slipping a low full toss on the pads, Starc won't miss out when he is in this mood. He swings it across the line and gets it past the backward square leg boundary.
Sohail Khan returns!
Comes down the track and defends it down the track.
FOUR! Poor ball and gets the treatment! Yasir Shah bowls it down the leg side, Smith paddles it neatly along the ground towards fine leg for a boundary.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Smith looks to play the reverse sweep but misses and it hit on the arm.
150 up for Steven Smith!

SIX! Down the track and away she goes! Steven Peter Devereux Smith gets to another milestone in style, growing in confidence is the skipper. Loopy ball around middle, Smith dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it cleanly over long on to clear the fence. A raise of a bat from him, will he be eyeing for a double ton now?
Drags his length short and gets it to drift a bit, Smith waits for the ball to come and then nudges it towards fine leg for a couple.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Smith comes down the track and defends it back to the leggie.
Yasir Shah is back into the attack!
Around middle and leg, Smith flicks it towards fine leg for a single. 16 off the over!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Makes a bit of room and drives it towards long off for a single.
Drops it short outside off, Starc pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
SIX! Take that, Azhar Ali! This was the googly, Starc seems to have picked it up as he once again swings it hard and tonks it again over Ali's head for back-to-back maximums.
SIX! Wallopped! Tossed up delivery around off, Starc clears his front leg and goes bang over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Into his pads, Starc flicks it behind square for a single.

Down the leg side, Smith tries to flicks it towards fine leg but the ball hits his pads and goes towards fine leg. Amir and Misbah even thought of reviewing it. Luckily they did not take it as it was pitched way down the leg side. Leg bye is taken.
Pitched outside off, Smith pushes it towards the point fielder.
WIDE! Way outside off, that was really tough even for the keeper to reach it.
Short delivery into the body, Starc fends it towards square leg for a single.
A bit short into the body, Starc camps back to defend it.
100-run partnership between Smith and Starc.
Angling into the pads, Smith flicks it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Again down the leg side, Smith nudges it on the on side for a single.
Way down the leg side, Smith tries to nudge it but is unable to make contact.
Tossed up outside off, Smith plays an inside out over the cover region for a couple.
Outside off, Starc pushes it through covers for a single.
Tossed up and Starc sits down and goes to heave it again over the mid-wicket region but is unable to contact.
Tossed up, Smith walks down the track and pushes it hard towards the long on fielder for a single.

A desperate review from Pakistan! Amir looks to angle it in on the leg stump, it's a full toss, Starc misses the flick and is hit on the pads. They all appeal but is was clearly going down leg. Pakistan take the review and replays show the impact was outside the leg stump and that is it. The decision stays as it is.
Angles in a full ball on middle, Smith swings his bat across the line and drags it off the inner part of the bat to fine leg for a single.
Very full on middle and leg, clipped towards fine leg for a single. Sohail Khan cuts it off in the deep and gets some appreciation from the crowd as he dropped Starc in the last over.
Amir bowls a length ball on off, Starc looks to pull, hits it hard but goes on the bounce to mid on for nothing.
Back of a length ball outside off, SS cuts it square off the wicket on the off side for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, Smith flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Australia are marching on nicely at the moment. How long will they bat? The lead is past 100 as well, maybe 100 more?
Mohammad Amir is back on!
Dragged short outside off, Starc stays in his crease to defend it.
Onto the stumps, Smith gets in line of the ball to flick it towards mid-wicket for a single. Australia lead by 100 runs.
Floated up, Smith camps back to defend it.

DROPPED! Seemed like someone applied the butterfingers cheatcode to drop that one. Tossed outside off and Starc tries to go hard over mid-wicket but the ball goes straight towards the fielder standing at long off who makes a mockery out of it. A run was taken in the process. Sohail Khan was the fielder there.
Tossed up, Smith camps back and pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Smith guides it towards point.
Azhar Ali comes in for a bowl.
Drinks has been taken.
Outside off, Starc camps back to defend it.
8th Test fifty for Mitchell Starc.

FOUR! Starc has reached to his half century in some style. Angling across outside off, he was quick to pull it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary. He has really supported Smith well and it is a quickfire fifty.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Smith walks across and guides it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads and Starc nudges it towards fine leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, Starc tries to play in line of the ball but is unable to make contact.
FOUR! STAND AND DELIVER! Pitched up and Starc stays in his crease to hit straight down the ground for a boundary. Beautiful shot.
Length ball outside off, Snith drives it towards mid on.
Yorker on the pads, Starc takes his front leg away from the delivery and guides it towards fine leg for a single.
Angling into the stumps, Starc tries to flick it but the ball hits his thigh pad in the process.
Pitched way outside off, Smith reaches out to it to push the ball towards the cover fielder for a single.
Length ball on the stumps, Smith covers his stumps to defend it.
Angling across the stumps, Smith shuffles and flicks it towards square leg for a couple.
Short of a length ball on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Leg bye! Strays on the pads, MS misses his flick as the ball goes off the pads towards the leg side and they take a leg bye.

Short of a length ball outside off, Steven Smith cuts it past a diving backward point fielder who dives but could only get a hand on it. The ball goes through and they cross for another double. Oh dear, there is a throw at the bowler's end but it is a bit far from Khan and Azhar doing the back up at mid on fumbles, hence, an extra run is taken. Three added to the total.
Short and outside off, Smith cuts it past backward point and some good running between the wickets allows them to come back for a couple.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched towards cover-point.
Short of a length ball on middle, Smith looks to pull but gets it off the toe end of the bat back to the bowler.
Way down the leg side, Starc tries to flick it but is unable to make contact.
Into his pads, Smith guides it towards square leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, Starc punches it towards mid off for a single and a direct hit on the non-striker's end from the fielder there would have got rid of Starc.

NASTY! Short ball into the body, Starc stays in his crease and tries to fend it on the on side but totally misjudges the line and length of the ball. The ball goes and hits his shoulder. He seems alright.
Way outside off, Starc goes fetching for it but is unable to reach it.
Length ball outside off, Starc goes to play for it but is unable to make contact.
Short and outside off, a little bit of width on offer. Steven tries to reach out to that one with a nice cut shot but finds the man at point.

Direct hit but no damage done! Good length delivery outside off, Starc punches it towards mid off and sets off for a single. The man at mid off charges to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end and it hits. No appeal for run out as Mitchell was easily in. A single taken.
Good length ball on middle, Starc gets across and defends it down the track.

Edged but falls short! Touch short and around off, Mitchell looks to defend but gets an outside edge and is lucky as the ball falls short of the man at second slip who dives to his left to stop it on the bounce.
Good length ball outside off, Starc looks to hit it hard through the line but once again fails to get any wood on it.
On a length and slanting from Starc, he tries to push it off his crease but is beaten completely.
Back of a length delivery, Smith stays in his crease to defend it.
Length ball outside off, Smith pushes it towards the cover region.
Angling into the pads, Smith gets back in line of the ball to defend it.
Wide outside off, Smith pushes it towards the point region.
Outside off from a length, Smith stays in his crease to defend it.
Length ball outside off, Smith leans forward to defend it.
Length ball outside off and Starc gets in line of the ball to defend it.
Wide outside off on a length, Starc tries to drive it but is unable to make contact.
Dug in short outside off, left alone.
Angling into the stumps, Smith shuffles across and flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A short delivery outside off which does not rise and Smith stays in his crease to defend it.
A bit short outside off, Smith drags onto his back foot to defend it.
Again a short one and Starc stays calm in his crease to defend it.
Short ball way down the leg side, Starc tries to flick it but is unable to make contact.
Length ball outside off, Starc leans forward to defend it.
Short delivery again and Starc camps back to defend it.

Again a short delivery into the body, Starc tries to fend it on the on side but the ball rises on him and goes off the arm guard straight to the keeper. There was a mild appeal there by the bowler which was denied quickly by the umpire. Replays show that the ball came off the arm guard but was not that far from the glove.
Short ball into the body, Starc stays tall in his crease to defend that right in front of his eyes.
Shortish outside off, Smith tries to cut it through the point region but is unable to make contact.
A bit outside off and Starc gets in line of the ball to push it through the cover region for a single.
Angling across, Starc stays in his crease to defend it.
Back of a length delivery, Starc stays in his crease and tries to flick it but is unable to make contact.
Back of a length outside off, Smith goes close to the delivery to push it through the point region for a single.
FOUR! GLAM SHOT! Back of a length ball outside off and Smith is quick to shuffle across and pull it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Sohail Khan is back in for a bowl.
Angling into the pads, Starc is quick to flick it towards square leg for a couple.
Back of a length outside off, Smith stays in his crease and pushes it through the point region for a single.
Length ball outside off, Smith shuffles and drives it towards mid off.
Angling into his pads, Smith flicks it towards square leg with a soft pair of hands for a quick couple.
50-run partnership between Smith and Starc.
Length ball outside off, Starc gets in line of the ball and pushes it towards mid off for a single.
Angling into the body, Starc gets hit on his thigh pad.
Wahab Riaz comes in for a bowl.
Short ball outside off, Smith again shuffles across and pulls it towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball outside off, Smith shuffles across and pushes it towards the point fielder.
Slinging in, Starc stays in his crease and pushes it towards mid-wicket region for a single.
Angling into the body, Starc tries to nudge it on the on side but is unable to make contact.
Angling into the stumps, Smith shuffles across and guides it towards mid-wicket for a single. 500 runs up for Australia.
Outside off on a length, Smith drags back and punches it towards covers.
Outside off, Starc tries to slog it again but is unable to make contact.
SIX! Tossed up and Starc is back at it again. He reaches out to the delivery and goes for a maximum over the long on boundary.
Floated on the stumps, Starc gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Yasir comes over the wicket and Starc stays in his crease to defend it.
SIX! HUGE! Tossed up outside off and Starc is quick to read it as he just hits it with sheer power over the square leg region for a maximum. Australia lead by 50 runs.
Outside off, Starc stays in his crease to defend it.
Way outside off, Smith tries to cut it but is unable to make contact.
Length ball outside off, Smith stays in his crease and guides it towards the point region.
Again a bit outside off, Smith is undisturbed there.
Way wide outside off, left alone by Smith.
Back of a length outside off, Smith cuts it hard towards the point fielder.
Length ball outside off, Smith shuffles way across off to defend it.
Outside off, Smith gets in line of the ball and pushes it towards the cover region for a single.
Smith leans into the delivery and defends it.

Tossed up and Starc is quick to get under it and go for a biggie but he is unable to find the distance. Starc goes for a slog and the ball hits the toe end of his bat and falls way short of the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
On the pads, Starc flicks it towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Short and wide outside off, Starc stays in his crease to punch it towards the cover fielder.
Tossed up outside off, Starc prods forward to defend it.
In the channel on off, Steven leaves it for the keeper.
Short and outside off, Smith shoulders his arms to it.

Amir uses his crease nicely and angles an inswinger on the stumps, ends up bowling a dipping full toss, Starc tries to jam it out but gets an inside edge that rolls behind square on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length served wide outside off, Smith goes after it as he punches it through point for a single.
Short of a length ball on middle, Starc fends it away on the leg side for a single.
Angling into the body, Starc stays in his crease to defend it.
Floated outside off, Starc pushes it towards covers and a misfield there helps them get a single.
Smith leans forward and drives it towards mid off for a single.
Tossed up again and Starc goes again for a big one but is unable to make the contact needed and the ball goes towards mid-wicket for a single.
Angling into the pads, Starc has guided it on the on side.
SIX! MASSIVE! Floated on the stumps, Starc sits down and hoists it over the mid-wicket region for the first biggie of the day. He seems to have some different plans altogether.
Tossed up, Starc prods forward to defend it.
Outside off, Smith leans forward to drive it towards the mid off fielder.
Another short one for Starc and he is uncomfortable playing it. He goes for a pull but the ball goes towards third man off the outside edge for a single.
Short and into the body, Starc tries to pull that delivery but the ball hits hard on his right shoulder.
Short and wide outside off, left alone by Starc.
Slinging into the body from a length, Starc punches it towards mid off.
Angling in from outside off, Starc stays in his crease to defend it.
Mohammad Amir is back in for a bowl.
Dragged in a bit short, Smith stays in his crease to defend it.
Outside off, Smith stays in line of the ball to drive it towards mid on.
Tossed up outside off, Starc sits and goes for a slog and lands up getting a single towards behind square.
Into his pads, Starc has guided that one towards mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, Starc pushes it towards the cover region.
Tossed up, Starc gets in line of the ball to defend it.
Yasir Shah will bowl from the other end.

FOUR! WHAT-A-START! That's a sensational shot on the up for the first delivery of the day. Pitched back of a length outside off and Smith pounces on it and punches it through the cover region for a boundary.

We are ready for the first session of the final day. The players are out in the middle. Steven Smith and Mitchell Starc will continue from where they left last evening. Sohail Khan to finish his remaining over. Here we go!!!

Pakistan on the other hand won't take the game very lightly as they very well know they are pushed firmly on the back foot and would have to be very careful stepping into day 5. What does the final day's play have in store for us? Let's wait and find out as the action isn't far away...

Australia have been fantastic with the bat, thanks to Warner and Khawaja who set the tone only for their skipper to explode from thereon. He is unbeaten on 100 and has the tail with him. The hosts will try to put up a good first session with the bat and then later would try to have a go with the cherry to give themselves a real chance.

Welcome for Day 5 of the second Test match between Australia and Pakistan. The weather seems to be kind as we have a clear sky and let's hope we get some good cricketing action on the final day but one thing is for sure, the home side would need a herculean of an effort to pull off a win from here.
... DAY 5, SESSION 1...

We hope you enjoyed our coverage today. Join us tomorrow for another early start at 0430 IST. Let's hope the weather holds up and we get to witness a thrilling final day of the Test. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Pakistan were erratic with the ball and leaked too many runs for their liking. Yasir Shah was disappointing and the home side took the attack to him. Only Wahab Riaz bowled testing lines and lengths and troubled the Aussies to scalp two wickets. They would look to come out and bowl better tomorrow to clean the lower order in a jiffy while the Australians will look to score briskly and take a lead of around 150 to have a crack at the tourists.

Rain has played spoilsport again and a tame draw seems to be on the cards. The Aussies hold the upper hand at the moment but the lead is only a meager 22 runs for them. The weather is not promising for tomorrow as well but if the rain stays away and we get a full day's play, it will still need something spectacular from the home side to pull off a win. Khawaja would be disappointed on missing out on his century by just 3 runs, but Smith has cashed in and has been terrific with the bat notching up his 4th Test ton of the year.
UPDATE 1120 IST - The official word from the umpires have come out and they have decided to CALL IT A DAY. It rained quite a lot and the umpires have taken the right call.
UPDATE 1030 IST - Better news from the MCG. The heavy rain has eased off and it's drizzling at the moment. The covers are still on. Let's hope for some positive news soon. Stay tuned with us.

UPDATE 0955 IST - Bad news, folks! The heavens have opened up and it is raining cats and dogs at the MCG right now. Let's hope the storm passes through soon and the weather clears out. The drainage at the MCG is brilliant and the groundsmen will be banking upon that. But for that, the rain needs to stop first. Stay tuned for further updates.
... DAY 4, SESSION 3 ...

The visiting side has scalped wickets, but have been unable to plug the runs leaking. Yasir Shah and Sohail Khan picked up the two to fall but Australia are in a good position here. All is not lost yet, there's still every chance to draw this match if not win it. And with the uncertainty about the weather, there's no telling how things could pan out. Hope the clouds clear up and we resume play on time. Join us back for updates.

The players walk off the field amidst all this and the home side will be the happier of the two. Steven Smith has once again come to the fore and notched up his fourth Test ton this year to put Pakistan on the back foot. Wade was dismissed quite early but the captain carried on. The Kangaroos lead by 22 runs going into the break and they'll be content with the position they're in.

The light has gotten quite dim and it's extremely dark out there. The umpire feel the light isn't sufficient enough to continue and hence, play has been temporarily suspended. To make things a little worse, rain has started to fall down too. So the track is being covered up by the groundstaff. With this break, EARLY TEA has been taken.
Back of a length outside off, Mitchell Starc punches this off his back foot to cover-point for a single.
17th Test ton for Steven Smith!

WELL PLAYED, STEVEN SMITH! He's a helluva player. What a knock! It's short and very wide outside off, this time the Aussie skipper gets it in the gap. It's between point and cover-point and the placement is good enough to get him three runs. Top, top stuff. Brings up his century in some good style. Completes the third run, removes his helmet and celebrates.
Short and pitched outside off, skipper Steven Smith with a back foot punch towards point. No run taken.
Back of a length delivery which nips in late, around off, Smith walks across a step and is cramped for some room as he looks to punch it away.
Short, wide and way outside off, Smith looks to go after it but it's too far out for him to make any connection.
Looped up on the stumps, blocked off the front foot.
A bit flat around off, Mitchell gets an inside edge onto his pads as he tries to play at it.

SIX! He's got a hold of that, hasn't he? Phew! That's a big, big hit. It's a big boundary out there. Tossed up around off, Starc gets low to this one, plays with the spin and slog sweeps it high and mighty over the mid-wicket fence. Sends it sailing miles into the stands for a maximum.
From around the wicket to the left-hander Starc, Yasir Shah with a tossed up leg spinner around off, it's kept out off the front foot.
Bit straight on middle and off, Smith gets back and works it in front of mid-wicket for a quick run. Moves on to 97 now.
Full outside off, Smith drives it crisply through the covers but finds the fielder positioned there.
Oooh... That was close. Back of a length just around off, Starc hangs his bat out to this and ends up getting an edge. Luckily for him, it falls just short of the slip cordon.
Shortish outside off, Starc is a bit cramped for room but still goes after it. Tries cutting it hard but misses.
Sohail Khan welcomes Mitchell Starc with a bouncer straightaway. Bangs the deck hard and Starc ducks under it.
Dark clouds are hovering over the 'G. It's gotten a bit dark and the floodlights have come on.
MITCHELL STARC is next in to bat now.

OUT! That's a good catch. Matthew Wade has to depart. It's on a back of a length and outside off, room on offer which seduces Wade. He slashes hard at it and gets an edge which flies behind to first slip. Asad Shafiq is the man there and he takes a sharp catch by bending low.
Back of a length outside off, kept out off the back foot on the off side.
Good length ball in corridor outside off, blocked off the front foot and into the track.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Quicker one pushed through outside off, Matthew is beaten for pace as he looks to cut it. The ball goes past the outside edge and lobs off the keeper's gloves.
Floats it up well and drops this on a driving length, invites Wade forward to defend.
Loopy leg-spinner around off, turning in, Wade plants his front foot across, gets to the pitch and blocks.
Has a change of angle and comes from around the wicket, tosses it right up there on middle and off. Matthew Wade presents a tight defensive shot to keep this one out.
Flighted ball outside off, SS comes down the track and eases it down to long off for one.
Short and wide outside off, Steven slashes this hard. Just cannot get the placement right as the ball runs down to the third man fielder for a run.
Harmless yet again, too far out and it's not bothered with.
It's too wide outside off, wide enough for Steven Smith to not have anything to do with that.
Good length ball in the channel outside off, no shot offered by the Australian captain.
Back of a length again and outside off, Smith walks across to cover the line and leaves it be.
FOUR! Almost dragged that on. Back of a length outside off, Smith looks to cut it away but gets a bottom edge which whiskers past the off pole. Goes past the keeper and away to the fence behind.
Tossed up on middle and off, Wade gets right behind the line, brings bat right in front of his pad and keeps it out.

Azhar Ali is down on the ground. The physio is out there and looking at him right now. Hope he's okay. A hit on the head is never to be taken lightly. He's been out there a long time too. He's being taken off the field for precautionary measures but he looks to be doing fine.

OUCH! THAT MUST HAVE REALLY HURT. Hope he's okay, because that was nasty. Yasir bowls a half-tracker on middle and off, Matthew Wade rocks back and pulls it hard. Azhar Ali is the man at short leg and he ducks immediately. The ball hits him right on top of the helmet and lobs away over behind towards short fine leg where Babar Azam comes running in to take it. It won't count as it is considered as a bounce when it goes off the helmet. Everybody has gathered around Azhar Ali to check on him. He's down on the ground right now.
Looped up and attacking the stumps, it's eased back down to mid on for a single.
Quicker one on middle and off, not much turn on this occasion as Smith strides forward to defend.
Loopy and quite full outside off, Steven Smith with a mistimed drives to Misbah-ul-Haq at short cover.
Yasir comes from around the wicket and tosses it up well outside off, Wade plants his front foot across and drives it towards wide mid off for a single.
On the shorter side once more, outside off, played to covers off the back foot to end the over.
Short and wide outside off, Steven Smith gets a bottom edge towards covers as he attempts to punch it away.
Angles across a shortish ball outside off, Matthew Wade opens the face and taps it towards backward point for a comfortable run.
Back of a length delivery around off, kept out off the back foot solidly.
Another wild pull from Smith, this time he gets it through mid-wicket. Will pick up a single.

FOUR! Big pull from Smudge. Just gave it the full swing of the bat. Back of a length into the body, Smith walks across, swivels and pulls it hard through backward square leg for a boundary. Scores are levelled now.
SOHAIL KHAN into the attack now.
Time for Drinks.
THAT ONE SPUN BACK SHARPLY! Bowls it shorter and on a flatter trajectory outside off, spins in venomously. Wade is opened up in his stance but manages to block it.
Spinning into the pads, worked through mid-wicket gently and good brisk running between the wickets allows them to come back for the second.
Tossed up on off, Wade lunges forward in defense.
Drags his length back and bowls it around off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Waits for this one and turns it past the short leg fielder.
Comes forward to the loopy delivery and defends it to the off side.
Hurls this one full and wide outside off, Matthew lunges forward and drives it with an open face through cover-point for a triple to get off the mark!
Full delivery outside off, driven nicely down the ground but finds mid off.
In the channel outside off, Matthew doesn't fiddle with that one.
Fullish ball on the stumps, Wade lunges forward and defends it nicely.
Length delivery on off, Wade camps back and defends it solidly.
Short of a length outside off, Wade points his bat skywards and leaves it alone.
Tossed up delivery, spinning away, cut away to point.
Tossed up on the stumps, swept away to the leg side for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
MATTHEW WADE comes out to bat.

OUT! YASIR SHAH GETS HIS SECOND WICKET! Good intelligent stuff from him! Goes wider of the crease and pushes it a bit quicker through the air and on a fullish length. Maddinson dances down the track but misreads the length. Looks to readjust and carve it away on the off side but misses the line completely and the ball spins back sharply to crash into the stumps. An important breakthrough for Pakistan. Australia are still in a good position as they trail by 10 runs.
Tossed up on off, Nic puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Fullish delivery outside off, pushed off the front foot to the covers.
Fullish delivery wide outside off, Smith lets it go.
Full length ball outside off, Smith walks across and with an open face places it behind point. Couple taken! He is flowing at the moment.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven to mid off.
FOUR! WELL PLAYED! Very fullish delivery wide outside off, Steven lunges forward and carves it behind point and the ball races to the fence.
Fullish delivery and it's straighter on this occasion, clipped nicely through square leg for a run.
On a length outside off, Nic camps back and plays it to point.
Tossed up on middle and leg, defended solidly off the front foot.
Advances down the track and eases it to long on for a run.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Smith prods forward and eases it through mid on for a single.
Loopy ball around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Camps back to the quicker one and defends it nicely.
50-run stand up for Smith and Maddinson.
On a length on middle, Smith shuffles and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
In the channel outside off, SS makes an easy leave.
On a length slanting across Steven. He covers the line and defends it solidly.
Fullish delivery wide outside off, Smith doesn't bother to play at that one.
Bowls a well directed bouncer around off, climbing up on Nic. He hops back and fends it off towards gully. Single taken!
Floated up on the stumps, Smith lunges forward and blocks it into the ground.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery
THAT'S A RIPPER! Bowls it quicker around leg stump, gets it to spin back in sharply. Steven closes his bat face early and gets a leading edge to the covers.
Quicker and a touch short outside off, Smith rocks back and cuts it late expertly. Gets it towards third man. Aslam sprints after it and puts in a slide to keep it down to two.
Tossed up outside off, driven to the covers.
Shortish delivery outside off, Maddinson waits for it and guides it behind point. Riaz gives it a chase but is low on energy. By the time he cuts it off, the batsmen come back for the third.
Fuller length ball on off, clipped with soft hands to the leg side.
Fullish ball outside off, driven to the covers.
Back of a length ball on off, Maddinson camps back and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Fuller length ball around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Maddinson allows it through.
Back of a length delivery, Smith hops back and works it through square leg for a run.
WAHAB RIAZ comes into the attack. Before the start of the previous over, Mohammad Amir had gone back to the pavilion. Probably went back for a breather.
Shortish delivery on the stumps, defended solidly of the back foot.
Smith eases this one with the spin through mid off for a run.
Almost a yorker on the stumps, Smith jams it down the track.
Tossed up outside off, played with an angled bat to gully.
Comes forward to the loopy delivery and defends it nicely.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shortish delivery this time, Smith pulls it to fine leg for a run.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Straighter on this ocassion, Smith shuffles across and clips it nicely through mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller length ball angling away from Smith. He comes forward and drives it with an open face past point for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length delivery on off, Smith comes forward and defends it.
Maddinson comes forward and defends it down.
Quicker one on the stumps, defended solidly off the back foot.
Fullish delivery on off, pushed back to Yasir Shah.
Comes down the track and defends it nicely.
Fullish delivery, pushed to mid on off the front foot.
Slow through the air outside off, driven towards widish mid off where it is cut off. Could have taken on Sohail Khan but doesn't.
Short of a length delivery slanting away from Smith. He covers the line and defends it down the track.
Shortish delivery attacking the body, Nic swivels across and plays a controlled pull shot to deep backward square leg. Single taken!
Dug in short this time, Maddinson drops his wrists and lets it go through.
Short of a length outside off, Nic stays back and defends it towards the gully region.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Shortish delivery on middle, rising up. Maddinson looks to hook it but misses it completely.
Camps back and blocks it from the crease.
Uses his feet to the loopy ball on the stumps and eases it to long off for a single.
Fullish around leg stump, clipped behind square leg for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Nic comes forward and drives it with the spin through mid on for a run.
STREAKY! Quicker one and shortish outside off, Smith is caught in the crease as he inside edges it past his stumps to fine leg. Single taken!
THAT'S A PEACH! Fuller length ball outside off, holds its line. Maddinson comes forward to counter it but is beaten all ends up.
Just back of a length ball angling in from outside off, Maddinson stays back and and pushes it to the off side.
FOUR! SLASHES AND SLASHES HARD! Bowls a back of a length ball outside off, Nic stays back and cuts it in between the slips and gully and gets a boundary to his name.
Full length ball wide outside off, Nic lunges forward and defends it to th off side.
Fullish ball on the stumps, driven to mid on.
Straying on the hips this time, nudged round the corner for a run.
MOHAMMAD AMIR to bowl from the other end.
Comes forward to this one and defends it nicely.
Drags this one short and wide outside off, cut away through point. Three runs added to the total.
Fullish delivery on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
Shortish and it's also slow through the air, Nic camps back and pulls it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Tossed up on middle and off, Maddinson looks to sweep it but is struck on the pads.
Shorter in length outside off, Maddinson camps back and defends it to the off side.

We are back for the second session. The players and the umpires come out in the middle. NIC MADDINSON to take strike. YASIR SHAH will continue his spell. It looks a bit overcast now, hope the rain clouds stay away. Here we go...
...DAY 4, SESSION 2...

So, the hosts just trail by a mere 48 runs. And with the pitch favouring the batsmen, they could really go on to score a lot more. They'll hope for the rain to stay away as there's forecast of it happening later in the day. The visitors need to strike early and strike quick, if they are to maintain a decent position in the game. Join us back in a short while for the second session.

The Pakistan bowlers bowled decently but that was never going to be good enough. They failed to really utilize the second new ball and only managed to scalp 2 wickets in the entire session, with Wahab and Sohail taking one each. They'll feel rather disappointed that they couldn't inflict any further damage to the Australian batting order.

A very, very good session for Australia. In the 34 overs played, they have scored 117 runs for the loss of just 2 wickets. The day started off with a bit of disappointment for Usman Khawaja as he failed to get to his century. But then Peter Handscomb joined his captain in the middle and the duo played comfortably well. They stitched a solid 92-run stand with Handscomb completing his fifty before departing rather softly.
Steve Smith lets that one go past him after covering his line and ensures that his team does not suffer any further damage. That will be LUNCH ON DAY 4!
Back of a length very close to the off stump, Nic Maddinson taps it in front of cover and scurries to the other end for a quick single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Fuller length ball angling in to the pads, it's clipped behind square on the leg side for one.
Sharp bumper from Wahab Riaz, Maddinson sways away a touch and drops his hands to let the ball go past him. Nicely done.
Steven Smith walks across and taps it wide of mid on for a single.
WAHAB RIAZ to bowl the last over before lunch.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a flatter trajectory, Maddinson works it in front of short leg.
Turning to Nic Maddinson on a fullish length, he plays with the spin and wrists it to mid on.
Steven Smith plays against the spin and turns it towards the square leg area for an easy single.
Loopy and fullish in length, outside off, it takes the edge and goes towards backward point.
Straighter one from Yasir, it's on a length and around off, Smith goes back and keeps it down on the track.
YASIR SHAH is back to have another go with the ball.
Tad fuller in length on middle and off, it's bunted back down the track but no run is taken. Dot ball to end the over.
Maddinson presents another firm block. He plants his front foot half-forward and deals with it easily.
Fullish in length and angled across just around off, solidly defended.
Another shuffle and another flick. He'll deal with these straight balls all day long. Gets it away to deep backward square leg for one.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Smith walks across like he typically does and blocks it back down the track.
Full delivery angling in on middle and leg, right in Steven Smith's area and he works it away comfortably. Brings the wrists into play and whips it through towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
On a good length, outside off once more, Maddinson with the full face of the blade blocks it on the off side.
Good line from Amir. Great shape on that and it just beats the outside edge. Just can't seem to draw that edge. He's been bowling superbly well.
Back of a length delivery angling in from around off, the southpaw opens the face of the bat and dabs it square towards point. No run taken.
Carries nicely through to the keeper as Maddinson leave it alone. Pitched it on a length in the channel outside off.
Rock solid in defense. Good stuff from Nic. Leans ahead and keeps this full ball out which tails in a shade.
FOUR! That'll give him some confidence. A bit too straight from Mohammad Amir and it's put away nicely. Fuller on the pads and Nic Maddinson clips this across the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Smith shoulders his arms to let that one through.
FOUR! He brings those wrists into play once more. So, so good in that area, isn't he? Once again Steven Smith walks across and whips it through the gap in the square leg region for a boundary.
20th Test fifty for Steven Smith!

Excellent knock from Steven Smith. Calm and composed as one can be. He drives this towards wide mid on and gets a couple of runs for it. Reaches his fifty and raises his bat to the crowd and his teammates as he acknowledges their cheers.
Full on the stumps, Maddinson drives it back down towards mid on for a quick single.
Nice length ball just around off, Maddinson leans across and punches it in front of cover-point.
Stays within his crease and keeps it out with a solid, straight bat.
Play and a miss! Kind of risky from Steven Smith there. It's fuller and around off, Smith looks to drive this through the covers but the ball goes past the outside edge and into the keeper's gloves.
Outside off, arms are shouldered to this one.
Pounded in hard and short on the stumps, Smith swivels across and pulls it away through square leg for a couple of runs. He moves on to 49 with that.
Fractionally ahead of a length, defended off the front foot.
Back of a length delivery angled across, Steven gets an edge as he hangs his bat out to this. It flies behind and falls just short of Azhar Ali at third slip.
An attempted yorker which just misses. Amir arrows it full on the stumps, Steven Smith walks across and wrists it to mid on. It's straight to the fielder so no run is taken.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Good length delivery outside off, Maddinson has nothing to do with that one.
NIC MADDINSON walks in next to bat.

OUT! SOHAIL STRIKES! And it's come completely against the run of play. Handscomb will be disappointed in the manner in which he's dismissed. Sohail Khan fires this full and wide outside off, Handscomb reaches out to it and drives it square on the up towards backward point where Sami Aslam takes the easiest of catches. Australia have lost their fourth wicket and a good knock from Handscomb comes to an end.
Length ball on off, it's blocked firmly down towards mid off.
Fuller again and pitched just outside off, driven straight to the man at mid off.
Fuller in length and outside off, Handscomb shoulders his arms to it.
Back of a length ball around off, it's tapped in front of covers and a brisk single is taken.
Back of a length ball on off, Handscomb lets it be as the ball goes over the off pole.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fuller length ball shaping in late, goes off the inside edge towards square leg and a single is taken.
Peter Handscomb drives this a bit square towards cover-point where a misfield allows the batsmen to take a run.
Short of a length pounded in hard on off stump, Handscomb stays rooted deep inside his crease to block.
Another watchful leave by Steven Smith and that brings an end to the over.
Back of a length ball outside off, Steven Smith walks down the track, covers the line and raises his bat to let it through.
Touch fuller on off, defended off the front foot into the track ahead.
Good length delivery outside off, disciplined stuff from Sohail Khan as he maintains that tight line, it's left alone.
Pitched just back of a length and outside off, it's kept out off the back foot on the off side.
Good length ball in the channel outside off, Steven withdraws his bat and ensures that the ball goes into the keeper's gloves.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tight line as it's kept close to the off pole, PH stands firm inside his crease, places himself behind the line and defends it rather solidly.
Angled across, quite harmless, Peter Handscomb is not going to have anything to do with that.
Short one from Mohammad Amir, it's ducked under cautiously by Peter Handscomb.

Back of a length delivery angled across, Smith hangs his bat out to it and ends up getting a thick edge. It flies and just falls short of the diving third slip fielder. It goes past him towards third man and a single is taken.
Good length delivery outside off, run down to third man for one.
Slightly full outside off, driven with the full face of the bat to the mid off fielder. That will be the end of the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shade of swing away from around off, Steven Smith covers his line well and watches the ball go past him.
Touch fuller in length and just around off, Smith prods forward and defends it presenting the full face of the bat.
On a good length and pitched outside off, no shot is offered to that one.

FOUR! That's an excellent shot from Steven Smith. The Australian skipper is so, so beautiful to watch when he bats like this. It's full and speared wide outside off, Smith leans into it and drives it through extra cover for a blazing boundary.
SOHAIL KHAN is into the attack now.
Length delivery outside off, left alone.

DROPPED! But it Amir's defense, it was a tough chance. Length ball on middle and off, Peter Handscomb stands firm and drives it uppishly straight back towards Amir. The pacer slips unfortunately in his followthrough and can't hold on to the ball with his left hand. Difficult chance goes begging.
Excellent delivery! On a good length and just around off, terrific shape on that. Handscomb tries to block it with a straight bat but the ball just about whiskers past the outside edge.
Pitches it right up there and attacks the stumps, driven to mid on. No run taken.
Angles it across once more, a bit on the shorter side too, it's left alone for the keeper to collect.
Back of a length delivery angled across Peter Handscomb, he does well to get back and keep it out with a straight blade.
And it will be MOHAMMAD AMIR to have a go with the new cherry first up.
The second new ball is available and already taken. Pakistan wasting no time in doing so.
Handscomb makes good use of his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and works it to the right of the bowler to pick up a single. That will be the end of the over.
On the shorter side once more, it's pushed a bit quicker through the air as well, punched through to deep cover for a single.
Shorter and flatter around off, SS goes back to keep it out.
Yasir seems to have found the right line and length now. Consistently hitting them well too. He floats it up just around off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Some nice drift for Yasir Shah on this occasion, bowls it nicely around off and draws Smith forward, he does well to come forward and defend it with a straight bat.
Tossed up leg break around off, blocked.
2nd Test fifty for Peter Handscomb!

FOUR! Easy pickings for Peter Handscomb. He couldn't have asked for an easier delivery to bring up the milestone. It's on a back of a length, he walks across and glances it fine down the leg side past a diving Sarfraz Ahmed to cannot stop it.
Fullish in length this time, it's flicked to mid-wicket.
Another short ball, another duck. Carefully done I might add.
Wahab brings out the short one and hits the deck hard, Peter Handscomb walks a long way across, ducks and lets the ball sail over him.
Another fuller length delivery on the stumps, this time Steven Smith walks across and flicks it through the square leg region for a run.
Wahab comes from around the wicket and fires in a full ball on middle and leg, Handscomb walks across and works it through square leg for a single.
Very, very slow through the air and tossed up outside off, the Aussie skipper has no trouble to let it through as he plants his front foot forward and shoulders his arms.
Drags the length back on this and bowls this on middle stump, Steven goes back and punches it towards the mid on fielder.
Looped up by Yasir Shah, another solid front foot defense presented by Steven Smith.
Lovely delivery. It's given some nice air and pitched on a driving length outside off. It's a bit slower through the air as Smith reaches out and drives it to the covers.
Floats it up once more and attacks the stumps, Steven Smith comes forward to defend.
Full and loopy on the stumps, it's eased back down to mid off for nothing.
Tucked past short leg for an easy single to keep strike.
Handscomb shuffles before Raiz could deliver but seeing this the bowler fires a yorker on the stumps. Peter still does well to keep it out on the on side for a single.
Plays a controlled pull shot through square leg for one.
Sprays it down the leg side, Steven doesn't look at it.
Fires in a yorker on middle, Smith brings his bat down to defend but gets a leading edge towards the off side for a couple more.
Angles it on the pads, Smith flicks it through backward square leg for a couple.
Drinks break!

FOUR! Good use of the feet! Loopy ball around middle and leg, Peter Handscomb comes down the track, gets close to the pitch of the ball and flicks it aerially towards wide long on. No one in the deep and he picks up another boundary of the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on off, defended down watchfully.
FOUR! Swept and swept hard! Tossed up delivery around middle, Handscomb gets down on one knee and sweeps it through mid-wicket. Made a good connection and gets a boundary to his name.
Pushes it quicker through the air and turns away after pitching, PH leaves it alone.
Tosses it up around off, Handscomb comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Past the leg gully! Short and angling down leg, Smith gets across and pulls it past Younis Khan at leg gully for a boundary towards fine leg. The extra ball has cost him a boundary.
And again! Goes wide of the crease and bowls a full length ball on the stumps, Handscomb moves across and nudges it towards fine leg for a single. Wahab oversteps again and will have to reload it.
Very full and angling in, Peter shuffles across and pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
Another short ball but it's angling down the leg side, Handscomb gets across and watches it go through to the keeper.
Short leg is in place now...
Here comes the sucker ball! After a couple of short ball he fires in a yorker on middle, Peter brings his bat down in time to keep it at bay.
Sharp bouncer from Riaz, Peter is happy to duck under.
Back of a length ball outside off, Handscomb hangs back and offers a straight bat defense.
Pushes slower through the air around off, it's once again defended down.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the front foot watchfully.
Smith lunges forward and keeps it out.
Full around off, Smith drives it hard but finds the cover fielder.
Tossed up around middle, swept towards fine leg for a single.
Comes down the track and defends it back to the bowler.
Comes across and tucks it towards square leg for a single to end the over.
Hits the deck hard and serves it outside off, the batsman ducks under it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
And here comes the customary no ball! Comes steaming in and fires in a full ball on the stumps, Peter keeps it out. The umpire calls it a no ball as Riaz oversteps.
Shortish outside off, Peter arches back to evade it.
Short and going down leg, Handscomb gets a long way across and then shoulders his arms.
Angles it on middle and leg, Smith shuffles across and tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
RIAZ returns for his second spell!
50-run stand between Smith and Handscomb!
Short and outside off, Smith punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Pushes it slower through the air around off, Smith gets on the front foot and pushes it towards covers.
Flighted ball around off, flicked straight to Shafiq at short mid-wicket.
Around middle and off, swept towards square leg for a single.
Tosses it up around off, Peter comes down the track and defends.
Loopy full toss around middle, Handscomb comes down the track and whips it towards short mid-wicket. There is a misfield there and he gets a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length delivery on off, Peter plays it with soft hands to steer it down to third man for one.
On a good length and outside off, Smith looks to defend but gets it off the outer part of the bat towards third man for a single.
Fuller on middle, defended towards the leg side.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Handscomb tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Stays behind the line and defends it with a straight bat.
Loopy ball around off, some bounce as well, defended towards point.
Flatter and quicker one on middle, Smith stays back in defense.
Loopy ball outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Around middle and leg, pushed towards mid on.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Peter comes down the track to flick but gets it off the inner half of the bat towards fine leg for a couple.
FOUR! Handscomb welcomes Yasir into the attack! Pushes it quicker through the air and outside off, Handscomb gets back and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
YASIR SHAH is introduced into the attack!
On a length and just outside off, Peter Handscomb stays put and fetches this from outside off over short mid-wicket. Three runs picked up.
Fuller on middle, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Bangs in a short ball on off, PH doesn't even look at it.
Deep point moves to third man...

FOUR! Over a leaping gully fielder! Khan dishes out a short ball outside off, Peter Handscomb waits and waits for it till the last moment and cuts it on the bounce. It goes over the man at gully who tries to stop it with a leap but the ball goes over him for a boundary.
Fuller on off, bunted back to the bowler.
Fuller on the stumps, defended on the leg side.
Angles in a length ball on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Leg gully is in place now...
On a length and straightens a bit, Handscomb looks to defend but once again the ball beats the outside edge.

Angles in a full length ball from outside off, Handscomb looks to work it across the line but misses and is hit on the pads. Before he could appeal the umpire stretches his right hand out to signal it as a no ball as he oversteps. Replays show the impact was outside off and would have gone on to hit the stumps.
On a length and straightens a bit after pitching, Peter looks to poke at it and he gets beaten once more.
Switches from around the wicket and keeps it full outside off, Handscomb looks to drive it but is beaten all ends up.
Angles it on the hips, tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Stays behind the line and defends it with a straight blade.
Angles it on the pads, PH looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Touch fuller on off, defended towards covers.
Shuffles a bit and tucks it towards square leg.
FOUR! Crunched! Short of a length ball outside off, Handscomb gets on the top of the bounce and crunches the punch through point to find the fence.
Back of a length ball on middle, Smith gets across and whips/pulls it through mid-wicket for three runs.
SOHAIL KHAN into the attack now!
Outside off, it's left alone.
Fuller in length and outside off, Peter looks to drive but there is no foot movement and the ball just whizzes past the outside edge to the keeper.
Fuller in length and served on off, Smith leans into it and drives it past a diving cover fielder. He waits for the ball to go through and then starts to sprint. Gets another three to the total.
Smith gets on the front foot and drives it straight to mid off.
SS chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
In the channel outside off, Smith lifts his bat and lets it go.
FOUR! Glanced away! Strays it on the hips, all Handscomb wanted was to get some bat on it. He does so as the ball races away to the fine leg fence. Plenty of runs in the over, 15 to be precise.
Comes from around the wicket and angles it in, Peter defends it down.

FOUR! Edged and through! This is frustrating for Riaz! He hurls a back of a length ball on off, at 144.5 kph, Handscomb is opened up as he looks to defend it. Gets an edge through third slip and gully for a boundary towards third man.
Very full outside off, Handscomb tries to drive it but the ball was too wide for him to make any contact.
This is off the meat of the bat! Slightly full and around off, Steven gets on the front foot and gets it through covers. Won't get a boundary but fetches him three there.
FOUR! Flayed! Fuller and served outside off, Smith looks to hit it through the off side but gets it off the outer part of the bat through point. It sped away to the fence in no time.
Fuller and wide outside off, Handscomb looks to drive it through the off side but gets an outside edge and falls just short of the diving keeper.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On a length and outside off, Peter hangs back in defense.
Fullish again on off, blocked towards point.
Fuller and fired outside off, Handscomb is happy to leave it alone.
Comes forward to this full ball and defends it down gently.
Length ball outside off, PH taps it towards covers for a single to get off the mark.
Comes from around the wicket and angles it in on middle, defended on the leg side.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Good length ball on off, Peter looks to punch it but it goes on the bounce to gully.
Fuller and on the stumps, at 149.3 kph, Handscomb gets back to this full ball and defends it down.
PETER HANDSCOMB is the new man in, replacing Khawaja!

OUT! Edged and gone. Usman Khawaja misses out on a ton here and much to his dismay, Wahab Riaz hasn't overstepped. Wahab hurls a length ball on off, gets it to move away from the batsman, Khawaja senses an opportunity to go for it and is undone by it. Nicks one behind and Sarfraz takes a regulation catch. He is all pumped up and why won't he be? Usman walks back with a forlorn face. Pakistan get an early wicket this morning.
In the corridor outside off, the batsman leaves it alone.
Length delivery on middle, Steven gets across and tucks it towards square leg for a couple.
Good length ball outside off, Smith looks to hang his bat out to defend but gets an outside edge which goes on the bounce to the gully fielder.
Fuller and hurled outside off, the Aussie skipper is happy to let it be.
Angles it in from outside off, SS defends it down safely.
On a length and moves away after pitching, Smith shoulders his arms to it.
Angled in on the pads, tucked towards fine leg for a couple.
Shortish on middle and off, Usman defends it with a straight blade.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Length ball on off, Khawaja is a bit squared up but still defends it down.
Touch short and outside off, played towards point again.
On a length and just outside off, pushed towards point off the back foot.
Once again angles it away from the Aussie skipper and the batsman shoulders his arms to it.
Slants it away from the batsman, it's left alone without much fuss.
Good length ball on middle, Steven stands tall and defends it back to the bowler.
Keeps it full and further outside off, Smith has got nothing to do with it.
Back of a length ball on off, Smith punches it straight to the man at covers.
On a length and angling away from over the wicket, Smith gets across, lifts his bat and lets it go.
MOHAMMAD AMIR will bowl from the other end!
Nips back in from off, the southpaw stays behind the line to defend it down. A maiden to start the day for Riaz!
Good length in the channel outside off, UK makes an easy leave to the keeper.
Once again he hurls in a full length delivery outside off, Khawaja comes a touch forward and keeps it out.
Slightly fuller and around off, defended off the front foot.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Usman gets across a bit and defends it on the leg side.
Starts with a back of a length ball outside off, Khawaja stays back and cuts it straight to the man at point.
The umpires and players have made their way out to the middle. It will be STEVEN SMITH and USMAN KHAWAJA to continue with the bat for the hosts. Pakistan begin with WAHAB RIAZ. Let's play...

Chasing Pakistan's 443, Australia aren't too far behind as Warner started off in a blazing fashion to register his first ever Test ton at this venue and that too at some real good pace. Usman Khawaja continued his impressive run of form and is still out there just 5 short of another century. They have enjoyed batting on this flat deck and look set to wipe out the deficit. Pakistan bowled well but it wasn't that threatening to give them the rewards. They would be hoping to come out afresh and scalp a couple of quick wickets to put the hosts on the back foot.

Hello and a warm welcome for day 4 of this Test match at the MCG. Before we talk about the match, let me tell you the news regarding the weather this morning. Khawaja and Smith are out there and the southpaw is just 5 runs short of another ton this year. He has continued his impressive form and looks hungry for more. The Aussies are in a safe coast thanks to the run rate at which Warner was batting, he has reduced the deficit to just 165 now. Pakistan bowled well in patches but it's just that they weren't that threatening. Amir and Sohail started off well with the new ball and then Riaz took over the reins but his overstepping let him down big time.

Riaz bowled a ripper to knock him over when he was on 81 but it was a no ball as he overstepped. He then made the tourists pay for the same with a swashbuckling 144 and eventually fell prey to Riaz.

Khawaja has looked solid in his approach and Pakistan would want to pick up a wicket or two quickly otherwise these two will keep the scoreboard ticking. Let's see how the final session pans out.

Slow through the air this time, Khawaja pushes at it off his front foot but gets another edge that goes wide of slip. Single taken!
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Fullish ball outside off, Usman goes for the drive but ends up getting an outside edge past first slip. Three runs taken!
Comes forward to this one and defends it nicely.
Quicker one around leg stump, defended to the leg side.
USMAN KHAWAJA comes in at 3.

OUT! YASIR SHAH DRAWS FIRST BLOOD! Good intelligent bowling from Shah. Tosses it up on the stumps, gets it to spin a touch and lures the youngster into a false shot, Renshaw kneels and goes for a slog sweep but misses it completely and the ball crashes into the stumps. That was a loose shot and he pays the price for it.  The tough resistance from Renshaw comes to an end and the Pakistanis are overwhelmed.
Stays back and defends this one.

Bowls a short of a length ball on off, played with an angled bat to point. Scurries through for a single. Shah hurls in an unnecessary throw at the bowler's end but there is no one to back up. Concedes an overthrow in the process!
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Taps this one with soft hands to the covers for a quick single.
No ball! Similar length ball outside off, Warner camps back and punches it through the off side for a triple. Riaz overstepped on that occasion.
FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Shortish and wide outside off, Warner stands tall and cuts it hard through cover-point and that races to the fence.
Short of a length ball outside off, Warner is up on his toes as he looks to place it through the off side but ends up getting a bottom edge past the stumps. Good diving take by Ahmed.
WAHAB RIAZ introduced into the attack.
Tossed up around leg stump, Matthew looks to sweep it but misses.
Walks down the pitch and works it to mid-wicket.
Renshaw plays this one with the spin to Misbah at short mid-wicket.
Bowls a straighter one outside off and its quicker through the air, Renshaw looks to defend but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Slips this one down the leg side, Matthew looks to turn it but misses.
A long hop down the leg side to begin with, Warner bends low and swats it through backward square leg for a run.
YASIR SHAH comes into the attack.

Amir has been terrific today. Has beaten both the batsmen on so many occasions. Angles in a short of a length delivery sharply from outside off, Renshaw shuffles across to counter it but gets beaten again.
Brings this one in from wide outside off again, left alone.
Goes wider of the crease and angles in a back of a length from outside off, Renshaw shuffles across to defend but gets beaten.
Similar length ball on off, Renshaw lunges forward and defends it solidly.
Fullish on middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
WARNER GETS BEATEN AGAIN! Bowls a fullish ball outside off, holding its line. Warner prods forward and goes for the drive but the ball whizzes past his blade.
Fullish delivery swinging into the pads, Warner clips it through backward square leg to retain the strike.
Camps back to the length delivery and defends it.
FOUR! LOVELY EXAMPLE OF BATSMANSHIP! Bowls a half-volley outside off, Warner meets it with the full face of the bat and time his off drive delightfully. Gets the desired result!
GREAT BOWLING! Angles across a fullish delivery well outside off, Warner shuffles across his stumps and feels for it but is beaten all ends up.
On a length around off, defended off the front foot to mid off.
FOUR! WELL CONTROLLED! Back of a length angling across Warner. He hangs back and glides it deliberately  through the slip cordon and the ball races across the turf to the fence.
Straying on the hips this time, Warner works it behind square on the leg side for a run.
This time he lunges forward to the fullish delivery and plays it with soft hands to the covers for a brisk single.
Dug in short outside off, Renshaw lets it sail through to the keeper.
Renshaw prods forward to the length delivery and pushes it to mid on.
Goes wider of the crease and angles in a length delivery at 143.4 clicks, Renshaw shuffles across his sticks and leaves it alone.
Full delivery attacking the stumps, clipped nicely in front of square and Warner gets three runs for it.
Good timing! Bowls a fuller length ball outside off, Renshaw prods forward and creams it through the covers for a couple.
Fullish ball on off, defended off the front foot to the leg side.
Renshaw shuffles across to the length delivery outside off and withdraws his bat at the last moment.
Back of a length on the stumps, tucked to the leg side.

FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Bowls a full length ball outside off, Matthew lunges forward and drives it down the ground. Misbah gives it a long chase from mid off and tries his best to pull this one back but the ball wins the race.
Short of a length ball outside off, Warner taps it to the off side and gets a single.
BEATEN! Length delivery outside off, shaping away. Renshaw pokes at it but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Slips this one wide outside off, Renshaw doesn't bother to play at that one.
Length ball outside off, holding its line. Renshaw pushes at it but gets an edge that falls short of fourth slip.
GOOD LEAVE! Bowls a length delivery wide outside off, shaping in. Matthew covers his off pole and lets it go.
Dug in short this time, Renshaw ducks under it comfortably.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Length delivery around off, shaping back a touch. Defended solidly off the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Back of a length outside off, played with an angled bat to point.
FOUR! EASY PICKINGS! Straying on the hips, Warner nudges it through fine leg and gets a boundary to his name.

THIS IS GOOD BOWLING FROM KHAN! Bowls a short of a length on middle and leg, angles across to leave the southpaw Renshaw. He gets squared up as he looks to defend but ends up getting an edge that falls well short of first slip. Single taken!
Camps back to the length delivery on middle and defends it.
Fullish delivery, pushed off the front foot to mid off.
The batsman has played it to the point region

FOUR! GREAT EFFORT AT POINT FROM YASIR SHAH! On a length outside off, Warner pushes at it hard off his front foot and gets an outside edge behind point. Shah leaps to his right but the ball eludes him and races to the fence.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Stays back and defends this one.

AN ABSOLUTE WASTE OF A REVIEW! Bowls a back of a length ball outside off, shapes away a touch after pitching. Warner is squared up as he looks to defend it but seems to have missed it completely. Sarfraz pouches it safely and goes up in an appeal. Misbah looks at Sarfraz but he is not sure. Decides to take the review after a long thought. The replays show that there is clear daylight between bat and ball. Warner has a wry smile about that.
Pakistan have taken a review against David Warner. There seemed to be nothing on that one.
WELL BOWLED! Bowls this on a driving length outside off, Matthew goes for the drive but is beaten by the away swing.
Back of a length wide outside off, punched off the back foot through cover-point for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
ANOTHER PLAY AND A MISS FROM WARNER! This is very unlike him. Bowls it fullish outside off and lures Warner into the drive. He obliges but gets beaten all ends up.
Back of a length around off, defended solidly off the back foot down the track.
Length delivery angling across Warner. He feels for it but gets beaten. He is looking uncomfortable out there.
On a length outside off, Renshaw comes forward and pushes at it but gets an outside edge that falls short of Azam at fourth slip who makes a good diving effort. Played that with soft hands.
Short of a length ball angling into Renshaw. He hops back and defends it to the slip cordon.
Almost a replica of the previous delivery as Renshaw shoulders his arms to let that through.
On a length outside off, Renshaw doesn't flirt with it.
Camps back to the length delivery outside off and punches it through covers to get off the mark!
On a length on middle and leg, Warner looks to clip it but gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball falls short of the man at short leg. This is good bowling by Amir!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a length on the stumps, Renshaw shuffles a bit and defends it.
Fullish ball around off, Renshaw comes forward and defends it down the track.
Bowls this one wider outside off, an easy leave for Renshaw.
In the channel outside off, angling away. Left alone!
Bowls it fullish around leg stump, going down leg. Renshaw looks to clip it but is struck on the thigh pad. Ahmed stops it behind the stumps.
SOHAIL KHAN to share the new ball from the other end.
Fullish ball on the stumps, defended solidly off the front foot.
On a length around off, holdings its line. Warner prods forward in defense.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Stays back to this one and defends it towards short leg.
Fuller length ball attacking the stumps, shapes in a bit. Warner is squared up as he gets a leading edge to the off side.
Fullish and straying on the pads, clipped by Renshaw through mid-wicket to get off the mark!
